articles.summary: IRAK4 is a key component of the myddosome, a protein complex that transmits signals from toll-like receptors (TLRs) and IL-1 receptors (IL-1Rs) to activate the innate immune response to infectious pathogens. While TLR/IL-1R activation is ordinarily protective, aberrant activation is at the root of certain highly morbid and sometimes life-threatening…
articles.title: Kymera’s IRAK4 degrader for hidradenitis suppurativa: Hitting an elusive target hard for a hard-to-treat inflammatory disease
